sources.label: Independent public accountant certification for wCOP - March 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The March 31, 2026 certification reconciles 104,898,654 outstanding wCOP across six chains and COP107,966,549.02 of collateral to a Colombian bank statement, then certifies that all outstanding tokens are backed by Colombian pesos at a financial institution in Colombia. The engagement is expressly a certification, not an audit or review, and the bank and account terms are not disclosed. Write-time re-open 2026-08-08: Ripio's current wFIAT page still reports the same wCOP circulation and Colombian bank-account collateral, while the certification remains the latest dated assurance artifact; no newer composition or named custodian was published.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Independent public accountant certification of the wCOP collateral as of March 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified; the Colombian financial institution, account type, and withdrawal liquidity are undisclosed.
